info.name: Customer360 — JamunaCustomer360 SQL Ticket Insertion
info.description: User-selected local development target: DESKTOP-BUDV4V7 / JamunaCustomer360. Ordinary API ticket creation through existing procedures, not the destructive QA suite. Prepared only; no live execution verified. The API server must use an approved restricted AGENT connection and real SQL mode. StartServices.bat forces mocks and is incompatible. Health detects mock mode but cannot attest the actual database/user. See JamunaCustomer360Setup.md.

item.name: 01 — Verify API is NOT using mock database

exec: pm.test('Real SQL executor selected, workers off',()=>{const h=pm.response.json();pm.expect(h.mockDatabase).to.eql(false);pm.expect(h.workersEnabled).to.eql(false);});

if (pm.collectionVariables.get('sqlPrerequisitesReviewed') !== 'YES') block('BLOCKED: approved Agent identity, JamunaCustomer360 target, local development provider isolation and committed ticket authorization must be reviewed first. See JamunaCustomer360Setup.md.');
if (!new RegExp('^https?:[/][/](localhost|127[.]0[.]0[.]1)(:[0-9]+)?[/]?$').test(base)) block('BLOCKED: configure the approved local loopback API URL.');
if (body && body.includes('{{serviceId}}') && !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('serviceId')))) block('Select a real published serviceId first.');
if (body && body.includes('{{versionId}}') && !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('versionId')))) block('Retrieve a published version first.');
if (body && body.includes('{{ticketId}}') && !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/.test(String(pm.collectionVariables.get('ticketId')))) block('Create a real SQL ticket first.');

if (body && body.includes('{{fieldValuesJson}}')) { try { const values=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('fieldValuesJson')); if(!Array.isArray(values)) throw new Error(); } catch(e) { block('fieldValuesJson must be a reviewed JSON array using actual published field IDs.'); } }
if(error || !response || response.code!==200) block('API health check failed; SQL request was not sent.');
if(h.mockDatabase!==false || h.workersEnabled!==false) block('BLOCKED: API must use real SQL with workers disabled. StartServices.bat forces mocks and cannot be used for this collection.');
